theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenRep_pairing_eq_continuous
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn N)) (μ μ' : Measure (Rn N)) (ν ν' : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ' ν' → ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ = ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν' x) ∂μ'
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
